mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tournament_matches (tournament_id, round, match_index, player1_user_id, player2_user_id, score1, score2, winner_id, next_match_id, next_slot, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{tournamentId}, #{round}, #{matchIndex}, #{player1UserId}, #{player2UserId}, #{score1}, #{score2}, #{winnerId}, #{nextMatchId}, #{nextSlot}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE tournament_matches SET player1_user_id = #{player1UserId}, player2_user_id = #{player2UserId}, score1 = #{score1}, score2 = #{score2}, winner_id = #{winnerId}, next_match_id = #{nextMatchId}, next_slot = #{nextSlot}, status = #{status}, rating_applied = COALESCE(#{ratingApplied}, rating_applied), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT m.*, u1.nickname AS player1_nickname, u1.avatar_url AS player1_avatar_url, u2.nickname AS player2_nickname, u2.avatar_url AS player2_avatar_url, uw.nickname AS winner_nickname FROM tournament_matches m LEFT JOIN users u1 ON u1.id = m.player1_user_id LEFT JOIN users u2 ON u2.id = m.player2_user_id LEFT JOIN users uw ON uw.id = m.winner_id WHERE m.id = #{id}

SELECT m.*, u1.nickname AS player1_nickname, u1.avatar_url AS player1_avatar_url, u2.nickname AS player2_nickname, u2.avatar_url AS player2_avatar_url, uw.nickname AS winner_nickname FROM tournament_matches m LEFT JOIN users u1 ON u1.id = m.player1_user_id LEFT JOIN users u2 ON u2.id = m.player2_user_id LEFT JOIN users uw ON uw.id = m.winner_id WHERE m.tournament_id = #{tournamentId} ORDER BY m.round ASC, m.match_index ASC
